mapper.select: SELECT ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CONF_RM_RSRV WHERE DEL_YN = 'N' AND TRUNC(BEGIN_DT) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) ) AS today_rsrv_count, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CONF_RM_RSRV WHERE DEL_YN = 'N' AND BEGIN_DT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW') AND BEGIN_DT < TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW') + 7 ) AS week_rsrv_count, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CONF_RM rm WHERE rm.USE_YN = 'Y' AND rm.CONF_RM_ID NOT IN ( SELECT r.CONF_RM_ID FROM TB_CONF_RM_RSRV r WHERE r.DEL_YN = 'N' AND SYSDATE BETWEEN r.BEGIN_DT AND r.END_DT ) ) AS available_rm_count FROM DUAL

SELECT rm.CONF_RM_NM, COUNT(*) AS rsrv_count FROM TB_CONF_RM_RSRV r JOIN TB_CONF_RM rm ON r.CONF_RM_ID = rm.CONF_RM_ID WHERE r.DEL_YN = 'N' AND r.BEGIN_DT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW') AND r.BEGIN_DT < TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW') + 7 GROUP BY rm.CONF_RM_NM ORDER BY rsrv_count DESC FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY
